purpose: Bounded product truth for preparing ServSync internal marketing drafts without inventing capabilities or results.
positioningConcepts: Keep customer service work organized from request through estimate, job, report, invoice, Home History, and follow-up.
Help small service contractors present clearer customer workflows without claiming enterprise automation.
Help homeowners keep service requests, decisions, documents, and completed work connected to the right home.

terminology.rule: Use the current homeowner-facing product name.
Use Customer in contractor-facing commercial workflows unless specifically discussing a connected homeowner account.
Describe secure request-free document access without implying a separate guest account or broad portal.
Estimate acceptance through a secure delivery session is not verified identity or a signature.
Production Stripe payments and Pay Online are not active.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Customers can start service work with a request tied to the relevant home and contractor workflow.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not promise emergency dispatch, guaranteed response, automated matching, or full external messaging.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Contractors can prepare, send, and track estimates tied to customer and work context.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Secure guest acceptance and bounded responses are not electronic signatures, negotiation, or payment.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Eligible Not connected Customers can receive a secure, expiring Estimate link and respond to that exact delivered version without creating an account.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not claim verified identity, signatures, guaranteed inbox delivery, SMS, replies, or a broad guest portal.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Contractors can keep jobs and finalized customer-facing work reports connected to the originating service workflow.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not claim code compliance, third-party certification, enterprise dispatch, or automated diagnostics.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Eligible finalized customer-facing reports can be delivered through a secure document-scoped link to a Not connected Customer.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not claim report acknowledgment, unrestricted document browsing, or access to private/internal content.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Contractors can create, review, send, and track invoices in the same customer service workflow.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not claim accounting synchronization, automatic collections, or live online payment processing.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Accepted Estimates can produce a deliberate draft Deposit Invoice, and authorized contractors can record manual or offline partial and full payments.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Job creation is not blocked by deposit state. Do not claim refunds, chargebacks, payouts, or Pay Online.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Homeowners can keep eligible completed work, reports, invoice records, documents, and manual reminders organized around their home.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not promise automatic timeline intelligence, recurring reminders, email, SMS, push alerts, or unlimited storage.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Contractors can maintain a recognizable business profile with supported business and service information.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not imply license, insurance, background-check, or credential verification unless separately verified.

unavailableOrRestrictedCapabilities: Production online payments or Pay Online
Automated email campaigns, SMS, or cold outreach
AI-generated recommendations, diagnostics, or autonomous approval
Guaranteed leads, marketplace ranking, or contractor performance claims
Public Trade Pack or professional HVAC content
Accounting, calendar, advertising, or CRM integrations unless later documented as active

categories: Invented customer, contractor, homeowner, signup, revenue, or usage counts
Invented savings, conversion, growth, performance, or time-reduction metrics
Testimonials, ratings, awards, rankings, guarantees, or unverified trust claims
Unsupported integrations, competitive comparisons, or unavailable functionality
Legal, licensing, certification, safety, or identity-assurance claims not established by the product
